name: model_maple_1
prompt: This is a crop of a photoreal plugin UI showing a pedal steel guitar. Output ONE image, landscape 1536x1024, where the instrument is redesigned as its own distinct model: a 1970s Nashville-style cabinet steel: a thick, squared birdseye-maple cabinet with a darker walnut-stained apron band along the front, four straight tapered maple legs set in from the ends with a slight outward splay, and a wide wooden keyhead end carrying ten individual open-gear tuners with ivory buttons. Keep EXACTLY the same camera, framing, scale, perspective, room, rug and lighting, and keep these parts exactly where they are and the same: the black fretboard with its fret lines, numbers and markers, the ten strings, the chrome tone bar, the pickup, the changer at the right end with its ten fingers where the strings end, the three foot pedals on their cross bar with their pull rods, the two knee levers under the front rail, and the height and line of the playing surface. It must look like a real, photographed instrument with honest wear. No text, badges or logos.
